name: NodeBB
description: Modern forum platform built on Node.js with real-time chat, notifications and plugin support.

envVars.description: Public URL the forum is served from

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATABASE: postgres
      POSTGRES_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      URL: {{env.URL}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/usr/src/app/public/uploads
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: nodebb
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: nodebb
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
